title: Branch Warehouse Storage Tariff — Factory Production Orders
content:
Units of Factory Production Orders delivered to a Ridgeline branch warehouse wait there until installation. The tariff below sets the class storage figures.

| Build class | Free storage after branch delivery (calendar days) | Storage fee per unit per billable week (USD) | Most storage fee per order (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 30 | 6.00 | 300.00 |
| Custom Color Build | 30 | 6.00 | 300.00 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 30 | 7.50 | 375.00 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 21 | 7.50 | 375.00 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 21 | 9.00 | 450.00 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 21 | 12.00 | 600.00 |

## Tariff terms common to every class

- **Week rounding** — started week: billable storage days become weeks by counting any started 7-day period as a full week.
- **Reschedule relief** — yes: delay caused by an installation reschedule that the company or the weather initiated is relieved from billable storage. The relief is given as a lengthening of the free storage period for each such reschedule on the order's installation job, in place of a day-by-day exclusion of the delay.
- **Cap** — the figure in the last column is the most storage fee one order can be charged in total.

## Reading the tariff (hypothetical figures)

| Billable storage days | Started weeks counted |
|---|---|
| 1 | 1 |
| 7 | 1 |
| 8 | 2 |
| 14 | 2 |
| 15 | 3 |

The started-week count is the same in every class; the free period, the weekly fee and the cap are the class's own.
